blocks.content: Project/chat navigator with three v3+ layers: a global transcript SearchBox (debounced, hits open the chat), per-project ⋯ popover menus (new chat, Finder, rename, delete with chats), and a Select mode for bulk operations with a sticky action bar (Delete N with confirm preview, Archive N, Move to project via the chat:move picker). Chat rows show ask-mode 🔒 badges, busy pulses, and per-row delete/archive.

The ⋯ menu button used to live INSIDE the ellipsis-clamped .project-name div, so a long project name hid it and project deletion became unreachable. The name now ellipsizes in a dedicated .project-name-text span while the button keeps a fixed flex slot.

The menu itself is position:fixed at the button's rect (top clamped to the viewport, left clamped to stay on screen), so the .project-sessions scroll container can no longer clip it. It closes on Esc, outside click, and window resize; the opening click calls stopPropagation so the window-level closer can't consume it, and clicks inside the menu stop propagation the same way.
Checkbox multi-select → Delete/Archive/Move with confirmation showing truncated titles.
Fixed-position menu; two-step delete confirm with 'also delete its N chats' default-checked.
api.searchChats with 250 ms debounce; results render with matching snippets.
